<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
<title>Pythagoras' theorem</title>
<style>
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{fill-opacity:0.25}50%{fill-opacity:0.6}}
.sq{animation:pulse 3s infinite ease-in-out}
</style>
<g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">
<!-- triangle: right angle at (330,330), a horizontal 120 long to (450,330)? use 3-4-5 scale 40: base 160 (b), height 120 (a), hyp 200 -->
<!-- vertices: C(300,300) right angle, B(460,300), A(300,180) -->
<!-- square on base (below): -->
<rect class="sq" x="300" y="300" width="160" height="160" fill="#2e7d32" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="2"/>
<!-- square on vertical side (left): -->
<rect class="sq" x="180" y="180" width="120" height="120" fill="#1565c0" stroke="#1565c0" stroke-width="2" style="animation-delay:1s"/>
<!-- square on hypotenuse: from A(300,180) to B(460,300), outward direction (up-right): vector (160,120), normal (120,-160) -->
<polygon class="sq" points="300,180 460,300 580,140 420,20" fill="#c62828" stroke="#c62828" stroke-width="2" style="animation-delay:2s"/>
<polygon points="300,300 460,300 300,180" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="3"/>
<polyline points="300,285 315,285 315,300" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380" y="390" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000">b²</text>
<text x="240" y="245" text-anchor="middle">a²</text>
<text x="440" y="100" text-anchor="middle">c²</text>
<!-- labels -->
<line x1="380" y1="300" x2="380" y2="360" stroke="none"/>
<text x="620" y="400" font-size="20" font-weight="bold">a² + b² = c²</text>
<text x="620" y="190">Hypotenuse (c)</text>
<line x1="610" y1="185" x2="540" y2="185" stroke="#000"/>
<line x1="540" y1="185" x2="540" y2="185" stroke="#000"/>
<text x="150" y="350" text-anchor="end">Side a</text>
<line x1="160" y1="345" x2="296" y2="250" stroke="#000"/>
<text x="540" y="470" text-anchor="start">Side b</text>
<line x1="530" y1="465" x2="440" y2="440" stroke="#000"/>
<text x="150" y="130" text-anchor="end">Right angle</text>
<line x1="160" y1="135" x2="302" y2="292" stroke="#000"/>
</g>
</svg>
